time_scope: Observed elapsed worker segment. It does not multiply campaign elapsed time.
activity: Read-only cache/interface inspection, symbolic address derivation, CPU address toy, and skeptical synthesis

wavefront.evidence_provenance: Already-fetched pinned source excerpts supplied by literature_audit worker

identities.row_group: The same row-group index addresses separate K/V tensors in each physical layer on one owner. It does not alias values across layers.
identities.terminal_source: For a completed adaptive token with D executed passes, A(token,slot)=computed_row(token,min(slot,D-1)).
identities.fixed_source: D=4 implies four distinct computed row groups. No cross-depth equality guarantee exists.
identities.prompt_source: Every full-R4 prompt position keeps four depth-specific computed row groups.

A_mixed_depth_no_alias.arena: One K arena and one V arena per physical layer. Each arena contains all recurrent regions.

B_terminal_row_alias.alias_scope: Only deeper uncomputed logical slots of a completed adaptive token

distributed_extension.requirement: Specify KV owner and compute owner. Charge every required activation/projection/result message. A local page table gives no free remote KV reads.

protocol.action: Allocate one private row group for the active token and recurrent slot.
protocol.precondition: The predecessor hidden state is ready. No other active row can write this group.

protocol.action: Write each physical layer's current K/V into that private group.
protocol.precondition: Historical mappings remain immutable. Deeper uncomputed slots remain unpublished.

protocol.action: Mark the group complete after the full recurrent pass finishes.
protocol.precondition: All required layer writes and the loop-boundary norm precede the original gate decision.

protocol.action: Continue with a new private group, or publish deeper aliases to the terminal group after exit.
protocol.precondition: Use the unchanged original gate, q, minimum depth, maximum depth, and BF16 payload.

protocol.action: Publish an immutable token-history snapshot before its successor reads it.
protocol.precondition: No global barrier across unrelated requests is required.

protocol.action: Keep table snapshots and referenced rows alive until their readers finish.
protocol.precondition: Metadata publication precedes attention. Completion precedes buffer reuse.

protocol.action: Release an unreferenced row and increase its allocation epoch before reuse.
protocol.precondition: No in-flight reader or retained branch references the old identity.

invariants: No read can refer to an unpublished current-token slot.
Every historical logical address resolves to the same K/V value as the explicit-copy reference.
Current append destinations are pairwise distinct within one attention launch.
Read-only aliases cannot become write destinations.
A losing branch cannot publish into the authoritative request generation.
An old row identity fails after its allocation epoch changes.
The initial protocol allows at most one recurrent token per request in flight.
Physical-layer identity remains distinct even when row-group metadata is shared.
Fixed R4 retains four logical and physical computed depth states.
Existing source and kernel behavior require independent numerical checks after any implementation.

cpu_toy.limitations: Distinct symbolic markers check address equality only. The test does not implement threads, atomics, reference counting, actual tensors, a GPU allocator, FA3 execution, gate decisions, or model outputs.
source_lines: assert len({pointers[q,t,s] for s in range(R)})==R

probe_modify_candidates.purpose: Allocate physical-layer arenas containing depth regions.
Replace scalar-slot routing with the explicit per-row contract.
Use stable graph metadata tensors instead of the scalar slot key.
Permit ready mixed-depth rows after the reader contract changes.
Pass row addressing through every physical layer without a scalar slot override.
Select the physical-layer arena and consume the corresponding row tables.
Publish terminal aliases only after the completed terminal pass.

verdicts.both_size_shape_compatibility: Same protocol with L24 or L48. Runtime execution remains separate.
verdicts.required_next_action: Test mixed-depth distinct regions first. Then test the documented page-size-1 reader independently. Do not combine allocator compaction and distribution into the first probe.
